about: Offline test set for the privacy filter (design note 31, app/ai/privacy_filter.py). Each case is text a person could type into Ask, describe a meal, a recipe request, their preferences or a custom food name. 'known' are the account's own names and its Care team's (what known_terms would read). 'remove': each string must be gone from the filtered text; the share that is gone is the measured recall. 'keep': each string must still be there (medical content, amounts, times, relative words). 'expected', when present, is the exact filtered text. Some cases are known misses (no cue word, lower case): they stay in the set so the recall is honest.
